scope: Read-only audit of Alena LEAP candidates on Manchester and Bombe, plus the exact accuracy/runtime artifacts consumed on ace.

notes.source: User-pasted Notion notes after ntn access failed
notes.ntn_status: 404 object_not_found; page not shared with Notion CLI integration
findings: CalDoT commands use standard weights/yolov5s.pt or weights/yolov5l.pt; notes explicitly link official v5.0 YOLOv5x/l/s downloads.
No pasted LEAP command references our dataset-specific best.pt checkpoints.
Notes show a TITAN Xp environment and mention a Freddie data transfer; neither establishes the host of the scored April invocation.
Month/day note headings do not explicitly specify a year.

exact_paper_input_chain.same_invocation_limit: CalDoT runtime includes two complete executions averaged per clip; accuracy holds one saved result per clip. Same output family is confirmed, but an exact accuracy-to-individual-runtime-invocation binding is not proven.

april_checkpoint_evidence.confidence: Strong launch-path, loader-log, checkpoint-identity, output-match, and reproduction evidence; no checksum recorded at original invocation.
april_checkpoint_evidence.loader: No --use_distill flag in retained launches. Current parser uses action=store_false and defaults True: Detector(args.weight). April logs corroborate the misleadingly named Distilled branch.
april_checkpoint_evidence.class_handling: Current/copied Detector keeps COCO IDs 2,5,7; no class-0 mapping.
april_checkpoint_evidence.inputs: Workspace videos/{caldot1-y5,caldot2-y5,amsterdam-y5}/test; workspace logs/outputs; Amsterdam also workspace motion_patterns.
april_checkpoint_evidence.source_caution: Current copied source passes YAML iou_thresh/conf_thresh to constructor conf_thres/iou_thres in reversed positional order. This was observed, not repaired during this audit.
april_checkpoint_evidence.historical_hash_limit: Retained shell history is undated and the checkpoint bytes were not checksummed at launch; current files and reproductions do not alone prove immutable historical bytes.

older_candidates.date_caution: March 12 timestamps cluster within seconds and indicate copy timestamps, not established execution dates.
older_candidates.pattern_libraries: All 60 pattern files per CalDoT dataset match April.
older_candidates.duplicate: old/caldot1 duplicates the older CalDoT1 candidate; old/caldot1_old and old/jackson also exist.
older_candidates.input_samples: All four checked old/April video pairs (CalDoT1/2 clips0,1) differ bytewise. Decoded-frame equivalence was not established.
older_candidates.detector_provenance: Unresolved: no matching launch log/checkpoint binding. Class IDs do not exclude every hypothetical older multiclass dataset-specific detector.
older_candidates.reuse: Not the paper source and not a verified reusable run with our exact checkpoints.

bombe.historical_source_limit: Files obtained from the bind-mounted checkout are current shared files, not frozen historical container source.
bombe.launch_history: Only tunnel/setup commands found; no LEAP launch arguments.
bombe.current_native_workspace: No /data/alenachao/data/leap-dataset currently present on native Bombe; the revision copy is separate.

our_checkpoints.launch_binding: Available on both workspaces, but no retained LEAP launch referencing these files was found.

student_artifacts.architecture: YOLOv5s students with YOLOv5l teacher; distinct from our dataset-specific x6 checkpoints.
student_artifacts.inference_binding: No retained scored inference launch references these artifacts; existence does not prove use.

metric_versions.duplicate_runtime_fix: Commit 33b7ec8 on 2026-10-26 changed CalDoT aggregation from summing two blocks to averaging per clip. Earlier totals: CalDoT1 144.5746s and CalDoT2 106.6378s.
metric_versions.revision_figure: Current renderer replaces HOTA using max(linear,pattern) from copied-workspace reruns but retains original corrected CSV FPS; it is a reconstruction-sensitivity figure, not one newly paired accuracy/runtime invocation.
metric_versions.fresh_rerun_caution: Refresh future FPS using the established speed.tsv inference_total-minus-decode convention, not an unverified sum of component timers.

conclusion: No verified existing Alena run with our exact CalDoT1, CalDoT2, and Amsterdam checkpoints was found. Evidence strongly supports standard YOLOv5x for the paper source; this does not prove that Alena never ran our detector elsewhere.
limitations: Deleted containers, unretained shell history, overwritten checkpoints, and arbitrary historical locations cannot be ruled out.
Exact historical checkpoint checksums and the older output set detector remain unproven.
Notion notes were read from the user paste because CLI access was unavailable.
